description: The policy also aims to create 500,000 new jobs in IT and allied sectors and raise the number of startups to 20,000
body_lead: Kerala cabinet clears IT policy 2026; AI, startups, tech parks to boost sector The Kerala cabinet on Friday cleared the IT policy, 2026, ramping up the state's IT infrastructure through improvements in Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology, tech startups and rapid job creation. The policy sets out to claim an ambitious 10 per cent of the nation's total IT exports, along with a 5-10 per cent share in high-tech sectors such as Space, Defence, Electronics, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Quantum Computing, and Genomics.
